title: Assistance and Counselling for Payment of Loan Instalments and Other Debt
what_it_is: Assistance and Counselling for Payment of Loan Instalments and Other Debt

sections.label: New housing loan rates
sections.summary: Current first-year rates for new housing loans are 1.4% to 1.8%, lower than last year's 1.8% to 2.3%.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: The current rates for new housing loans are between 1.4% and 1.8% for the first year, which are lower than the range of 1.8% to 2.3% last year.

sections.label: MAS waives TDSR MSR
sections.summary: MAS has temporarily waived TDSR and MSR requirements for refinancing loans for investment residential and non-residential properties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As a temporary debt relief measure, MAS has also waived the TDSR and MSR requirements for refinancing loans for investment residential and non-residential properties.

sections.label: Mortgage and SME deferments
sections.summary: As at 10 May 2020, close to 90% of 31,300 mortgage deferment applications and over 90% of 3,300 SME secured loan deferment applications were approved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: As at 10 May 2020, close to 90% of the 31,300 applications for mortgage loan payment deferment have been approved.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Similarly, more than 90% of the 3,300 applications for SME secured loans deferment have been approved.

sections.label: Defaults after deferment ends
sections.summary: Loan deferment helps now, but after the temporary relief Bill term ends in about six months, more defaults are likely.

sentences.speaker: Mr Kwek Hian Chuan Henry (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The first is, regarding the loan deferment, it will help right now, but in maybe six months' time, after the temporary relief Bill term ends, there will likely be a lot more defaults.

sections.label: Public Service jobs and credit spread
sections.summary: If private sector hiring is insufficient, the Government should consider funding Public Service jobs, and schemes by ESG, MTI and MAS control credit spread with Government taking 90% of risk.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: If the private sector is not hiring enough, one area we look to is the Public Service including Credit Counselling Singapore, and I think if there are opportunities there, the Government should be prepared to put in money and we can see how to create more of such jobs, including in the Public Service, such as what the Member had suggested.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: I do not see any particular reason, as the Member mentioned, that the credit spread has gone up.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: There have been schemes run by both ESG or MTI and MAS to make sure that the credit spread is controlled, with the Government putting in and taking 90% of the risk.

sections.label: Banks adjusting interest rates
sections.summary: When a bank adjusts interest rates, it should always give customers enough time to refinance loans without penalties.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ong Ye Kung
sentences.text: Whatever it is, when a bank decides to adjust interest rates, always give enough time for your customers to be able to refinance the loans and without penalties.
